notes.title: patch in 12.31
notes.notes:
The combat difficulty is adjusted. You will not block every enemy attack by the sheath，damage can still be prevented but maybe you will be knock away, and not all the enemy move could be interrupted.

The energy will recover harder. choose a good time for your slash。

Some bug is fixed.

notes.title: 12.26 Patch
notes.notes:
Tricky enemies now can throw oil on your face.
Wipe quickly!

Catch the annoying rogue. it made of GOLD!

notes.title: New level before release！
notes.notes:
Now we have guide and training level for you to try the Iaido moves. and you can fight enemys in front of aisa temple, on a flying B-52,and in a castle.

A calabash is added to recover your health and energy. 

And there are two new enemys,Meet the Shuriken and shieldbash!
